text_003: From your ERP to every AI need across the organization, we put AI at the centre of the business. With solutions built on the SAP, OpenAI and Anthropic ecosystems and our Enterprise AI Hub platform, we transform organizations' systems, data and business processes end to end with AI.
text_004: From AI that runs inside your ERP to an Enterprise AI Hub that manages AI needs across the organization, we bring AI to every layer of the business. By connecting systems, data and processes, we deliver end-to-end AI transformation.
